scope: Deterministic provider-neutral German ASR scoring harness for identical-corpus comparison of Nemotron/Qwen3-ASR/Whisper. Measures WER, CER, exact technical-term retention, partial stability/finalization latency fields when supplied, preserves condition labels such as unassisted vs context-biasing, and fails closed on corpus-set mismatch and causal timestamp inversion. Harness readiness grants no model/runtime/V4/V6 credit.
